biur-halacha/3:_.en: Since they are two-on-two and are not in the category of hadas shoteh — see Bikkurei Yaakov who wondered about this: nevertheless they are not in the category of hadar mentioned in the Torah, which is specifically three leaflets; and see there that he proved that even those who are lenient in a time of need only permit two-and-one, but for two-and-two we have no support unless we rely on the view of Baal HaShlamah who permits in a time of need to recite a berachah on three species. And behold, in any case, although all the poskim disagree with him, nevertheless in any case this reason does not apply among us, since hadassim that are nice three-on-three grow among us; and even though in responsa Shevut Yaakov he wished to invalidate them on the account that they are grafted, they already disagreed with him in the responsum of Chacham Tzvi and Pnei Me'orot, and the halachah is with them; and the custom has already spread everywhere to render them kosher, for it is known that they are not grafted; and since one can fulfill the mitzvah with these, even if in the city there is only one of them, it is not called a time of need to recite a berachah on three species without a kosher hadas. Therefore, fortunate is one who buys for himself even only one hadas that is three-on-three and will complete with two other hadas branches that are two-on-two, if his means do not reach to buy three hadas branches that are three-on-three; or the congregation should take for themselves a lulav with hadassim three-on-three and the entire congregation fulfills through it — end of his words.

mechaber/2:main.he: היו ענביו מרובות מעליו אם ירוקות כשר ואם אדומות או שחורות פסול ואם מיעטן כשר ואין ממעטין אותם בי"ט לפי שהוא כמתקן עבר וליקטן או שליקטן א' א' לאכילה הרי זה כשר: ומיום ראשון ואילך כשר בכל ענין: (ב"י בשם ארחות חיים):
mechaber/2:main.en: If its berries outnumbered its leaves and they are green, it is valid. If they are red or black, it is invalid. If their numbers were diminished, it is valid, though we do not diminish them on Yom Tov because it is considered fixing. If one sinned and picked [the berries] or one picked them off one a time to eat them, it is valid. And after the first day, they are valid in any event . {Rama: (Beit Yosef in the name of the Orkhot Hayyim)}

mechaber/3:main.he: ענף עץ עבות האמור בתורה היא ההדס שעליו חופין את עציו כגון שלשה עלין או יותר בגבעול אחד אבל אם היו שני העלין בשוה זה כנגד זה והעלה השלישי למעלה מהן אין זה עבות אבל נקרא הדס שוטה: הגה ופסול אפי' בשעת הדחק ואיכא מאן דאמר בגמר' דכשר וע"כ נוהגין באלו המדינות לכתחלה לצאת באלו ההדסים המובאים ואין ג' עלין בגבעול אחד ויש מי שכתב דהדסים שלנו אין נקראים הדס שוטה הואיל והם שנים על גב שנים ואינן כהדס שוטה המוזכר בגמרא ולכן נהגו להקל כמ"ש מהר"י קולן ומהר"י איסרלן ז"ל בתשובותיהם:
mechaber/3:main.en: "Boughs of a dense-leaved tree" [Leviticus 23:40] talked about in the Torah are myrtle whose leaves cover its tree, with three or more leaves from one node. However, if there are two leaves at the same level, one opposite the other, and a third one above them, this is not considered dense; rather, it is considered wild myrtle. {Rama: And it is valid, even in an emergency. There is an opinion in the Gemara that it is valid. That is why in these countries, we initially use these myrtles that are imported and do not have three leaves from one node. There is one who says that our myrtles are not considered wild myrtle because they are two by two and are not like the wild myrtle in the Gemara. Therefore, our practice is to be lenient, following what was written by Mahari"i Kolon and Mahar"i Iserlin z"l in their responsa.}

mechaber/4:main.he: יצאו הרבה בקן אחד ונשרו מהם עד שלא נשארו אלא ג' בקן אחד כשר אפי' נשרו רובם כגון שהיו שבעה ונשרו מהם ארבעה ונשארו שלשה:
mechaber/4:main.en: If there were many [leaves] from one node and they fell off leaving only three in one node, it is kosher, even if the majority fell off, like if there were seven and four fell off.

mechaber/5:main.he: למצוה בעינן כל שיעור אורך ההדס שיהא עבות ולעיכובא ברובו [ואפי' אינו בראשו] [טור]:
mechaber/5:main.en: For the mitzvah, we require the whole length of the myrtle to be dense. In order to hinder fulfilling the obligation, a majority suffices. {Rama: (even if it is not at the top} (Tur)}

mechaber/6:main.he: יבשו עליו פסול כמשו כשר:
mechaber/6:main.en: If they completely dry out, they are invalid. If they are slightly dried, they are valid.

mechaber/7:main.he: שיעור היבשות אפילו אם נפרך בצפורן אם עדיין ירוקים הם כשר ואינם נקראים יבשים אלא כשילבינו פניהם:
mechaber/7:main.en: Regarding the criterion for dryness, even if they can be disintegrated by a fingernail, as long as they are still green they are kosher. They are not considered dry, just whitened.

mechaber/8:main.he: יבשו רוב עליו ונשתיירו בראש כל בד מהג' בדין קן אחד ובו ג' עלין לחין כשר ויש מפרשים שאפילו אם מהשלשה שבחד קינה יבשו שנים ולא נשאר כי אם אחד לח כשר והוא שיהיה העלה שהוא מורכב על שניהם:
mechaber/8:main.en: If most of its leaves dried out, but there remains on each of the three branches a stem with three non-dry leaves, it is valid. Some say that if among the three on one stem two dried out and there is only one non-dry leaf, it is valid, provided that the leaf is above the other two.

mechaber/9:main.he: אם אותם עלים שלא יבשו הם כמושין יש פוסלין ויש מכשירין:
mechaber/9:main.en: If the leaves that did not dry out are semi-dry, some say they are invalid and some say valid.

mechaber/10:main.he: נקטם ראשו כשר אפי' לא עלתה בו תמרה והוא הדין ליבש ראשו ויש פוסלין בנקטם ראשו: הגה וטוב להחמיר במקום שאפשר באחר [המגיד] ולא מקרי נקטם אלא אם נקטמו העצים (ר"ן):
mechaber/10:main.en: If its top is severed it is valid even if no berry grew in its place. The same is true if its top is dried. Some invalidate the severed top. {Rama: RAMA: It is best to be stringent in places where you can get another (the Maggid}. It is not considered severed unless the wood is cut (Ra"n}.}

mechaber/11:main.he: אם אין לו אלא הדס שענביו מרובים מעליו ביו"ט נוטלו ואינו מברך עליו:
mechaber/11:main.en: If one only has myrtle whose berries outnumber its leaves, one should take it on Yom Tov and not bless on it.
